class.name: LandscapeLayer
class.brief_description: A material layer painted on a [Landscape3D].
class.description: Describes the surface of one of the (up to 16) weight-blended layers of a [Landscape3D], similar to the layers of a landscape material in Unreal Engine. The textures of all layers are resized to [member Landscape3D.layer_texture_size] and packed into two texture arrays: albedo + height, and normal + roughness + ambient occlusion. Missing textures are replaced by neutral values.

members.member: Color multiplied with the albedo texture.
Strength of the ambient occlusion texture.
Amplitude in meters of the micro detail displacement generated from [member height_texture] close to the camera. Requires [member Landscape3D.micro_detail_levels] to be greater than [code]0[/code].
How much the layer height is used when blending with other layers ([code]0[/code]: weight blend, [code]1[/code]: height blend, like [code]LB_HeightBlend[/code] in Unreal Engine).
Height texture (red channel), used for height blending and micro detail displacement.
The name of the layer, displayed in the editor.
Roughness of the layer (multiplied with [member roughness_texture] if set).
Size in meters of one repetition of the textures.
If [code]true[/code], the layer is projected on the three axes and blended by the terrain normal, avoiding stretching on cliffs.
Sharpness of the blend between the triplanar projections.
Rotation of the texture coordinates, useful to break the repetition between layers.

signal.name: textures_changed
signal.description: Emitted when one of the textures of the layer is replaced or changed. [Landscape3D] rebuilds its layer texture arrays in response.
